description: This file defines the 'EventWrapper' class, which encapsulates event variables, manages dependencies on other wrappers like enums and custom objects, and provides utility methods such as retrieving event codes as a string. It is part of a code generation system related to event handling and code templating.

classes.name: EventWrapper
classes.description: A class representing a wrapper around an event variable, managing its dependencies and providing related utility functions.

methods.name: EventWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the EventWrapper with a given EventVariable and sets up its section mask.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the dependencies of this event wrapper.

methods.name: getEventCodes
methods.description: Returns the list of event codes (names) associated with this event.

methods.name: setEventCodes
methods.description: Sets the list of event codes for this event.

methods.name: getEventCodesString
methods.description: Returns the event codes as a comma-separated string.

methods.name: buildDependencies
methods.description: Analyzes the event variable's contained variables to identify and add dependencies such as enums, other events, or custom objects.

methods.name: addDependency
methods.description: Adds a wrapper as a dependency and aligns its language mask with this wrapper.
